programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E57 Eternal Leave [English Dub]
programme.desc: The battle for a nation's soul descends into chaos. Bradley unleashes death on those who dare engage him. Beneath Central, the one responsible for the Fuhrer's creation unleashes something far, far worse.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub] (2011)
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E58 Sacrifices [English Dub]
programme.desc: Mustang must make a difficult choice: will he break alchemy's greatest taboo? Or will he watch the person dearest to him die? Meanwhile, it grows ever more difficult to discern where Ling ends and Greed begins.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub] (2011)
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E59 Lost Light [English Dub]
programme.desc: As the light of the sun vanishes, Mustang learns the loss which comes from seeing the other side of the Gateway - and five sacrifices gather in the dark presence of the Father.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub] (2011)
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E60 Eye of Heaven, Gateway of Earth [English Dub]
programme.desc: The light is gone. Shadows swallow everything. As the planet quakes and the heavens tremble, the souls of heroes and villains alike vanish into darkness. The circle is complete.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub] (2011)
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E61 He Who Would Swallow God [English Dub]
programme.desc: Millions of lifeless bodies litter the landscape of Amestris, and a being with the power to create suns is unleashed upon the world. Unless Hohenheim has something amazing up his sleeve, all is surely lost.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub] (2011)
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E62 A Fierce Counterattack [English Dub]
programme.desc: A truly epic battle erupts when Edward, Mustang, Hawkeye, Greed, Izumi, and Armstrong attack the god-like Father. The odds are against the forces of good - until one brave boy makes a shocking sacrifice.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub] (2011)
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E63 The Other Side of the Gateway [English Dub]
programme.desc: When the battle ends, the one known as Father meets his final fate beyond the Gateway. When the one known as Fullmetal enters the sacred space, he finds only the promise of a new beginning.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub] (2011)
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E64 Journey's End [English Dub]
programme.desc: As one shared journey ends, many journeys begin. Those most touched by the conflict which surrounded the Philosopher's Stone now go their separate ways. One thing is certain: they will meet again.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP06 Black Star [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid the Phantom Thief attempts a bold clock tower robbery in a building swarming with the police, but his real rival takes the stage here for the first time, turning the endeavor into a fierce battle of wits!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP07 Kuroba Kaito's Busy Day Off [English Dub]
programme.desc: When Inspector Nakamori catches a glimpse of Kaito's face during an attempted robbery, the young magician has to "prove" he's not Kid the Phantom Thief by going on a date with Aoko at the same time Kid is supposed to make his next appearance!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP08 Adult's Charm [English Dub]
programme.desc: Real magic comes back to haunt Kaito in the form of Akako. This time, the sorceress is so annoyed with her classmate that she plots to wipe him out when he's in his Phantom Thief identity. And to stack the deck, Akako turns Inspector Nakamori into a murderous thug!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP09 Enter: The Phantom Lady [English Dub]
programme.desc: In the present, Kaito and Aoko are lured into a trap at the top of the Toto Tower, while in the past, the first Kid the Phantom Thief and the mysterious Phantom Lady have an exciting first encounter at the top of the Eiffel Tower!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP10 Phantom Lady and the Ryoma Treasure [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid's first order of business is saving himself and an unconscious, handcuffed Aoko as they plummet from the top of Toto Tower in an antique car. Assuming he succeeds, the next challenge is finishing his mother's last job, bringing a crooked antiques dealer to justice. But his mother never had to deal with the brilliant diminutive detective, Edogawa Conan!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP11 Kid, Conan, and the Ryoma Treasure Illusion [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Detective Conan crossover concludes with a night at the museum, in which Kid goes out of his way to return stolen items amid a crowd of adoring fans, the police who want to take him down, and a couple of real criminals!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP12 Two Kid the Phantom Thieves [English Dub]
programme.desc: When the greedy owner of a department store has an employee impersonate Kid the Phantom Thief to steal the Star of the Giants, he doesn't count on the real Kid showing up on Christmas Eve to foil his plan!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP13 Get Away from Him [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito takes a break from thieving to go on his class ski trip, but when his teacher holds a couples-only masquerade ski tournament, he finds himself in a tug-of-war between the witchy Akako and childhood friend Aoko!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP14 Crystal Mother [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kaito and Aoko are on a luxury train with the Queen of Ingram, her son, and the Principality of Ingram's Crystal Mother, a huge topaz that may contain the Pandora jewel. The queen has the real jewel cleverly hidden, though, making it a challenge for Kaito/Kid to find it before the train reaches Osaka. On top of that, he's got competition, as there's a Snake on the train!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP15 The Princess and the Thief's Improv [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a princess with a priceless jewel comes to town, Inspector Nakamori is sidelined by a detective from her country who shoots first and... shoots again later, until his quarry is killed. Naturally, his target is Kid the Phantom Thief!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP08 Adult's Charm [English Dub]
programme.desc: Real magic comes back to haunt Kaito in the form of Akako. This time, the sorceress is so annoyed with her classmate that she plots to wipe him out when he's in his Phantom Thief identity. And to stack the deck, Akako turns Inspector Nakamori into a murderous thug!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP09 Enter: The Phantom Lady [English Dub]
programme.desc: In the present, Kaito and Aoko are lured into a trap at the top of the Toto Tower, while in the past, the first Kid the Phantom Thief and the mysterious Phantom Lady have an exciting first encounter at the top of the Eiffel Tower!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP10 Phantom Lady and the Ryoma Treasure [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid's first order of business is saving himself and an unconscious, handcuffed Aoko as they plummet from the top of Toto Tower in an antique car. Assuming he succeeds, the next challenge is finishing his mother's last job, bringing a crooked antiques dealer to justice. But his mother never had to deal with the brilliant diminutive detective, Edogawa Conan!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP11 Kid, Conan, and the Ryoma Treasure Illusion [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Detective Conan crossover concludes with a night at the museum, in which Kid goes out of his way to return stolen items amid a crowd of adoring fans, the police who want to take him down, and a couple of real criminals!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub] (2014)

programme.desc: When the greedy owner of a department store has an employee impersonate Kid the Phantom Thief to steal the Star of the Giants, he doesn't count on the real Kid showing up on Christmas Eve to foil his plan!

programme.desc: Kaito takes a break from thieving to go on his class ski trip, but when his teacher holds a couples-only masquerade ski tournament, he finds himself in a tug-of-war between the witchy Akako and childhood friend Aoko!

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

programme.title: Exploring Ethnic Attire: Dong Elegance
programme.desc: Dong clothing weaves together tradition, craftsmanship, and the unique identity of the Dong ethnic group. In this episode, we’ll unravel the stories behind the intricate designs, vibrant colors, and deep cultural significance of Dong attire. From ceremonial garments to everyday wear, each piece is imbued with the essence of a rich heritage.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5
programme.desc: In this final episode, Tianran journeys to Nyingchi, known as “Xizang’s Garden.” Here, he experiences the region’s semi-pastoral way of life — feeding yaks, trying his hand at archery, and seeing how tourism is transforming lives in Lulang International Tourist Town. Travelling along National Highway 318, Tianran discovers towering millennia-old cypress trees and rafts through the vast Yani National Wetland Park, before ending the day with a unique spa treatment at a traditional Tibetan hospital.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the “La’aomen” harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: “Mountain Orchid Rice”.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of milu deer
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China’s rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: "Foodwise" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. From the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods!

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.7
programme.desc: Jiangsu---an aquatic lowland stitched together by the Yangtze and Grand Canal. From Yellow Sea wetlands populated by red-crowned cranes to the Yangtze estuary's port history, this is a land and coast where maritime legends are made!

programme.title: Navigating the intersection of logic and art
programme.desc: Today, we continue with our new series “All the Lives We Live,” spotlighting five young Chinese people who are breaking the mold. They’ve taken unconventional paths, excel at what they do, and infuse passion and personality into every step. In their own way, they’re redefining what it means to be young—and promising—in today’s China. In this episode, we meet Xu Mengran. Xu leads a double life as both a textbook editor and a Peking Opera enthusiast. Let’s see how this unique balance of logic and art fuels her creativity and pushes the boundaries of what it means to be successful.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky (2024)
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.sub-title: Amplify USVI: The Global Stage: St. Croix Blowing Up
programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. Featuring voices like Asta Williams, Willard John, Rashidi Clenance, and Vio International, the episode explores how genres such as quelbe, calypso, and scratch band music were born from the island’s complex past. Through storytelling, performances, and cultural insight, Naydyeyah reveals how the rhythms of resilience and celebration continue to echo through generations.

programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas uncovers the revolutionary spirit woven into the music of St. Croix, where sound has long served as a rallying cry for justice and identity. programme.title: Man Eats Wild S2
programme.desc: De lokale bevolking vertelde Mario dat er diep in de woestijn van Namibië een vreemd uitziend wezen met een grote voedingswaarde leeft dat al honderden jaren door mensen wordt geoogst.

programme.title: South Seas Spearo S2
programme.desc: We return to Fiordland in the hope of going one step better in slotting a hapuka on a spear, but the presence of Bluefin Tuna off the coast, and Wapiti Bulls on the slip faces proves a tempting distraction from the task at hand!

programme.title: South Seas Spearo S2
programme.desc: Following a ridiculous sequence of events in Fiordland, the team saddle up and head for the hapuka haven of the Chatham Islands, where they spend a few days diving the spectacular & remote Pitt Island.

programme.title: Gold Fever S1
programme.desc: It’s a big year for the Cripple River mining camp in Nome Alaska. The participants are finding some of the biggest gold in recent history.

programme.title: Gold Fever S1
programme.desc: After dredging Arctic Creek for years, Tom and Kia finally open up the hole in hopes of striking it big.

programme.title: Gold Fever S2
programme.desc: Kia challenges Tom to a fierce competition: whoever finds the most gold using just one tank of gas wins the ultimate winner-takes-all prize.

programme.title: Gold Fever S2
programme.desc: Tom and Kia take a helicopter deep into the remote Alaska wilderness to investigate a mysterious old silver mine left behind by the Buzzard.

programme.title: Wardens S5
programme.desc: De dag van een Warden begint vroeg, met een kans om een veroordeelde wildstroper op te pakken die al meer dan drie jaar uit handen van de wet weet te blijven. Maar zodra de ene zaak wordt afgerond, staat de volgende alweer voor de deur – en dat betekent doorwerken tot diep in de nacht.

programme.title: Wardens S5
programme.desc: Wardens uit Regio 4 worden opgeroepen om een agressieve bul van 450 kilo onder controle te krijgen. Maar dit jonge dier weigert zijn veilige omgeving te verlaten. De Wardens moeten drastische maatregelen nemen om de situatie in goede banen te leiden.

programme.title: Wardens S5
programme.desc: In Regio 1 stuiten de Wardens op een kraker die illegaal op openbaar terrein verblijft — en ze zijn met stomheid geslagen. Ondertussen staan Wardens uit Regio 5 paraat tijdens het jaarlijkse Yellowstone River Boat Float-evenement.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1
programme.desc: In de multiculturele centra van Parijs en Londen kunnen de spanningen hoog oplopen. Het is aan de politie om de verschillen te overbruggen en de vrede te bewaren - dagelijks aan het werk om enkele van de drukste hoofdsteden van Europa te beschermen.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1
programme.desc: In Hyderabad, India, bestaan rijkdom en armoede naast elkaar. Elke dag strijden 15,000 agenten tegen criminaliteit variërend van diefstal tot interreligieus geweld. In Palestina staan 8,500 politieagenten voor een nog grotere uitdaging: werken in een gefragmenteerd, politiek gespannen landschap waar elke patrouille risico's met zich meebrengt.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1
programme.desc: In Catalonië heeft de regionale politie het overgenomen van de Spaanse nationale politie en een snelle-reactie-eenheid op motoren ingezet om de stedelijke criminaliteit aan te pakken. Ondertussen werkt de politie in Haifa, de belangrijkste havenstad van Israël, volgens strenge wetten in een gespannen omgeving die wordt gevormd door terrorismedreigingen en het voortdurende regionale conflicten.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots S1
programme.desc: Een onverwachte storm zorgt ervoor dat Island Air moet vechten om zijn vliegtuigen op tijd binnen te halen voor verplicht onderhoud.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots S2
programme.desc: Tanalian Aviation strijdt tegen het winterse weer in een poging om ijsklimmers naar de Knik-gletsjer te vervoeren.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots S2
programme.desc: Joel Natwick en Josiah Freeman, de piloten van Tanalian Aviation, verlenen hun assistentie aan een zoek- en reddingsoperatie. Het gaat om een ervaren wandelaar diep in de winterse wildernis.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4

programme.title: Mitti
programme.desc: Deva, a villager, goes on a violent rampage to avenge his sister's rape, and soon finds himself battling both the criminals responsible and the police.

programme.title: Vighnaharta Shree Siddhivinayak
programme.desc: Manav Mehta is a successful industrialist whose personal life is in disarray. His parents leave home because of his uncourteous behavior. After problems at work, his car breaks down on the way to work, and he unintentionally visits the Siddhivinayak temple. This visit changes his life.

programme.title: Anjaana Anjaaani
programme.desc: The film of two strangers, who meet on a bridge intending to commit suicide. After bonding over their shared miseries,they make a pact to live life to the fullest for the next 20 days and explore various adventures together. As they embark on this trip, they begin to develop feelings for each other, leading to a complex and emotional journey. Will they embrace their new-found love or stick to their original plan?

programme.title: Badal
programme.desc: Badal witnesses his family being massacred during a riot in his village. He is raised by a terrorist and soon sets out to exact revenge on the police officer responsible for his family's murder.

programme.title: Krishna Cottage
programme.desc: The movie revolves around a group of college students who visit a haunted house called "Krishna Cottage." As they unravel the mystery behind the house, they uncover dark secrets and a vengeful spirit that haunts them

programme.title: Dance Hits
programme.desc: Pure nostalgia on the dance floor! Celebrate the vibrant sounds of old-school Hindi dance music with timeless beats and retro charm.

programme.title: Shahenshah Of Bollywood-83rd Birthday Special Vol 2
programme.desc: Iconic melodies of Amitabh Bachchan reflecting romance,pride, and cinematic brilliance.

programme.title: Zindagi Ka Safar
programme.desc: Dive into the emotions of life, with a collection of heartfelt songs that beautifully capture the highs and lows of life. Let these timeless tunes resonate with your emotions and experiences.

programme.title: Dilip Kumar – Tributes To A Legend
programme.desc: Celebrate the voice of a generation with songs immortalized by the charisma of Dilip Kumar. Soul-stirring ghazals, patriotic numbers, and emotional ballads that reflect a cinematic titan’s journey.

programme.title: Masti Bhare Geet
programme.desc: Feel-good songs to groove to. Perfect for boosting your mood and adding fun to any moment – pure, carefree energy!

programme.desc: Liz brings back an old mirror from her travels in Egypt. This one is enchanted and opens a door towards ancient Egypt where a Goddess, Neferkitty, has a secret wish: conquering the human world.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Two little devilish girls are coming visiting Jon. They really want to play dolls with Garfield and Odie, who only want to stay clear from them.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield is stuck in a parallel world where cats have taken the place of humans, and vice versa!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon sends Garfield to Dr Whipple's Show in order for him to learn how to be a well-behaved cat.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield accidentally climbs into an outer space traveller's car, which sends him into parallel worlds.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Sir Leo, a famous TV Actor, looks very much like Garfield. So when he has to go on vacations, Garfield takes his place and gets to taste celebrity and glitter.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Our heroes are on a fishing trip. Odie saves a little fish and goes to explore the underwater world with Garfield.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Liz asks Jon to look after her goldfish while she's out of town. When Garfield finds this out, all he can think about is the great fry-up he's going to have.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Our friends are having a picnic by the lake. There's an extra guest: a cute little wolf, who will become Odie's new friend.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield finds a watch which can stop time.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: It's Liz's birthday and Jon wants to offer her a special gift: a nice family portrait. But taking this picture will be a gruelling experience for Garfield, Odie and Jon...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Professor Bonker has a new invention: the "Virtualodeon", which will bring the characters of Garfield's favourite TV Shows right into his living-room.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Herman the Postman is going on holidays. He has left his round to the young Steart O'Meara, who hasn't yet encountered all of Garfield's devilish traps...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: It's winter and Garfield and his friends, Odie and Nermal, are competing for the price of "the best Christmas carolling singer". There are cookies at stake!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon's cousin has passed away and has left his fortune to Jon and Doc Boy. But there's one condition: the one who will spend an entire night in a spooky manor will be the one to inherit everything.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: After Garfield slightly changes the recipe of Odie's birthday cake, it comes to life and spreads panic in town!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield has been mean to Odie again. Left in the garden, he's taken in by a neighbour, Nathan. Odie is happy with this new friendship, but he soon discovers that Garfield wasn't that bad after all...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield takes us through the ages to tell us the history of dogs. As we know, he has a poor opinion of them, but an incident will make him change his mind. After all, all dogs are not useless!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield is bored. He has nothing to do. Well, not exactly: watching Odie and the squirrels in the garden, there's fun ahead after all!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Eddie Gourmand has built a super attraction park, made completely out of cheese. Squeak and his friends beg Garfield to take them there but with Harry working as a security guard, it won't be easy!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Pooky has disappeared again, but this time, it's Nermal who finds it. He is willing to give it back to him at one condition: Garfield has to be really nice to Nermal for the rest of the day!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield's cat instincts push him to climb on a tree. But how will he get down? Everyone tries to give him a hand, but they end up stuck in that tree! Now he's out on a limb; who will save him?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Nermal doesn't believe in super heroes. Garfield does and he tries desperately to convince him. Even if that means disguising himself as Ultra Powerful Guy.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield receives a strange helmet which lets him read everyone's thoughts. He even catches aliens' conversations who are just about to conquer Earth! Garfield has to stop this plot immediately!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: After Odie dreams of being a super hero, Garfield mocks him for it. But when Garfield really gets into trouble, Odie puts his grudges aside and flies off to help him. And this time he REALLY flies!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Nermal makes a bet with Garfield: if Garfield manages not to eat for a whole hour, he won't see Nermal for a whole month. Will Garfield be victorious ?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: A caveman has been found in a block of ice. When Garfield accidentally thaws him, he falls in love with Olga. But if there's no caveman in the new exhibit, the museum will be ruined!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: There's a new employee at the pound: it's a robot with all the latest gadgets and it's job to make all the pets stick to the straight and narrow!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Tis the holiday season for Garfield and the whole gang. Jon has invited not only his parents and Doc Boy, but Liz's family as well, and so Garfield must be on his best behaviour.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon's Christmas plans take a turn for the unexpected, prompting Garfield to learn that there's more to Christmas than opening presents and eating!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: How can Garfield make the cutest cat in the country look ugly? It won't be easy but our orange friend is VERY motivated...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Ah! A pizza dinner in a countryside cottage, doesn't that sound nice? Yep, except when the house is haunted.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: How can Garfield get rid of Aunt Ivy, who hates animals? Garfield has an idea.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: When the owner of an outer space fast food chain plans to turn all the inhabitants of Earth into chickens, Garfield becomes our unlikely hero.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: A retelling of the history of the cat throughout time, as told by Garfield. But is it really a retelling of history, or a rewriting?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield, from now on, you're on a diet! Don't argue, it's for your own good!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Gravity-free cooking, have you ever heard of such a thing? According to Garfield, it's delicious...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Yahooooo! Jon has won the lottery!!! But... but where is his ticket?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Bad news: Jon's nieces are coming over! The ones who love to dress Garfield up? You got it.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon has become allergic to Garfield. But what if the only solution is to get rid of him?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield has always said he would go to the ends of the earth to eat lasagna. And that's exactly what he's going to do!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: In your opinion, who should you call to rid a house of mice? An exterminator, or Garfield?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie is accidentally sold to Mr. Allwork, an awful lawyer who wants to sue Jon, and Garfield must find a way to get him back or never be fed again!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon, Odie and especially Garfield have to put up with an unexpected houseguest with big demands and an even bigger appetite.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: It would be fantastic to get tomorrow's newspaper today, wouldn't it? Jon could play all the winning numbers in the lottery and then Garfield could eat tons of pizza, unless...

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: What starts out as a romantic night at Vito's for Jon and Liz could end up in a marriage with children, all thanks to Garfield stomach.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield will stop at nothing to get his hands on Chef Squisito's lasagna, which his wistful student claims is the 'best lasagna in the world."

programme.desc: Garfield is the unwilling guinea pig for his young neighbour's newest invention: a size altering ray.

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: Portlandia (2014)
programme.desc: A celery salesman (Steve Buscemi) goes to great lengths to get celery back on the table. 911 dispatchers assure callers that it's beets. The Order Grill is open for lunch. Carrie declares social bankruptcy.

programme.title: Portlandia (2014)
programme.desc: A punk from the '80s wakes up from a coma. An e-mail goes neglected. Nina has surprising news for Lance. Malcolm and Kris tailgate a Prairie Home Companion live show. Carrie dates a tax lawyer.

programme.title: Portlandia (2014)
programme.desc: Peter drives Nance to the emergency room. Spyke gets a car. Ghavin has some questions for a singer (Annie Clark) whose band is touring through Portland. Fred and Carrie have a garage sale.

programme.title: Portlandia (2014)
programme.desc: Carrie and Fred go home after a concert. Fred has an idea for a music documentary. Peter is reunited with his old band, The Bahama Knights and his ex-wife lead singer (Maya Rudolph). Guest starring Maya Rudolph, Tuck & Patti, and Jeff Tweedy.

programme.title: Portlandia (2014)
programme.desc: Kickstarter videos compete at the Can'ts Film Festival (hosted by Gus Van Sant). Toni and Candace coach the Portland Trail Blazers' dance team. Guest starring Gus Van Sant, Paul Allen, The Portland Trail Blazers & dancers.

programme.title: Portlandia (2014)
programme.desc: Brendan and Michelle decide that it's finally time to try drugs. Carrie's brother (Josh Homme) comes to visit with his new boyfriend. Women and Women First is visited by the cops. Guest starring Kyle MacLachlan, Dan Savage, and Josh Homme.

programme.title: Portlandia (2014)
programme.desc: Mr. Mayor (Kyle MacLachlan) unveils Portland's official 3D Printer. Santa is concerned about the future of Christmas. A minister (Ed Begley Jr.) reminds us that church is an option.

programme.title: Portlandia (2014)
